Subject: Follow-up: DeepFin discovery + pricing / next steps

Hi Ellis / Sofia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps from our call: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Current usage: prototype using LLM for summarization + 1:1 assistant (roughly 2M tokens/mo today).
- Growth signal: product roadmap expects steady growth to ~10–15M tokens/mo over the next 6 months if pilot metrics look good.
- Key success criteria: response latency under 300ms p95, predictable unit cost, and enterprise security controls (SOC2 + VPC).

Pricing & qualification items we need to confirm so we can pull together a formal proposal:
1) Token volume cadence: is 2M/mo your current steady state and is the 10–15M a forecast or a required target for launch?
2) Budget range: what monthly/annual budget band should we target? (helps us size committed-use tiers).
3) Unit economics target: do you have an internal target $/1M tokens or target cost per feature for the launch?
4) Discount preference: are you mainly looking for a startup program credit (short-term) or a committed-use discount (12–36 months)?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- If you can share a rough token run-rate (today / 3mo / 6mo) we'll draft 2 pricing options: (A) startup program credit + low-commit pilot, (B) committed-use (12mo) with stepped discounts.
- We can include multi-year incentives if you want to lock a 24–36mo committed spend.

Attached: Redwood_Startup_Program_Terms.pdf (summary of standard startup credits and eligibility).

Happy to hop on a short follow-up with Ben (cc'd) — he can run a quick calc on unit economics once we have volumes.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below: 

1) Volumes: prototype today ~2M tokens/mo (summaries + assistant). If pilot metrics are good, we expect to ramp to ~8–12M/mo within 3–6 months; steady-state target for launch ~10M/mo.
2) Budget: for pilot phase we're looking at $2k–$6k/month depending on unit economics. For launch/scale we can stretch to ~$10k+/month if the cost per feature stays reasonable.
3) Unit economics: we don't have an exact $/1M target yet — ideally we want something in the $100–$200 per 1M tokens range or lower for scale.
4) Discount preference: we'd prefer a committed-use discount if the math works; open to startup credits to kick off the pilot and then switching to committed pricing if we hit expected volume.

Procurement: looping in procurement email above; they will need a MPA + standard security questionnaires.

Thanks for the details, Ellis. A couple of clarifying items from the engineering/SE side so we give you an accurate unit cost calc: 

- Token mix: are most tokens short-generation assistant replies (~50–150 tokens) plus summarization (longer chunks)? If you can share average tokens per call/summary that helps.
- Sequence length distribution: p95 seq length and typical context window (helps us pick model and quantization profile).
- SLA priority: will you need a production SLA (Gold) or is Pilot OK on standard Availability? SLA affects routing and therefore cost.

Quick back-of-envelope on unit economics based on typical workloads (for discussion):
- Baseline (no commit / hosted): ~ $200 per 1M tokens
- 12-month committed tier (mid): ~ $120 per 1M tokens with a 12mo spend commitment (example: 10M tokens/mo -> $1,200/mo)
- 24–36mo multi-year: ~$90–$100 per 1M tokens with higher commit or annual prepay

These are illustrative — we can run precise numbers once we have token cadence and SLA. I'll attach a draft Master Purchase Agreement (MPA) for procurement to review.

-Ben

Ellis / Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on your notes and Ben's estimates, here are two clean options we can propose formally: 

Option A: Startup pilot + transition
- 3-month pilot with Redwood Startup Program credits: 50% credits up to $5k total in credits (applies to hosted usage).
- No long-term commitment during pilot.
- If you hit >=8M tokens/mo by month 3, we escalate to Option B with retroactive credit offset applied to committed plan.

Option B: Committed-use (recommended for predictable unit cost)
- 12-month commit: example commit = 10M tokens/month. Pricing: $120 per 1M tokens (monthly billing).
  - Example: 10M tokens/mo -> $1,200/mo.
- 24-month commit: $100 per 1M tokens (or $95 with annual prepay).
- 36-month commit / larger upfront: $90 per 1M tokens + additional onboarding credits.
- All committed plans include reserved capacity routing, 99.9% uptime SLA tier (optional add-on), and priority support.

Notes on the economics: if your launch volume is ~10M tokens/mo, Option B (12mo at $120/1M) gets you to ~$1.2k/mo which looks squarely within your stated post-pilot budget if you prioritize predictable costs and scale. Option A gives you runway to validate with smaller upfront spend.

Next steps:
- Tell us which option you prefer and any preferred commit size (e.g., 8M / 10M / 15M tokens/mo).
- We'll generate a formal quote + MPA (Ben attached draft) and route to procurement.

If procurement wants an initial SOW or different billing cadence, we can accommodate — happy to sync at a time that works.

Best,
